name: Complete Profile Requires Email Verification
summary: The user supplies the required registration profile fields; the server persists them only on the PendingIdentity and requires independent NuvIoT email verification before durable identity resolution.

preconditions.expression: an OAuth-external PendingIdentity is active, provider proof is valid, and no durable user has been created

inputs.name: Email
inputs.description: Registration email to prove independently through NuvIoT.

serverInteraction.intent: Persist the submitted profile on the PendingIdentity and place the ceremony behind the independent email-verification gate without creating a durable user.

postconditions.expression: the PendingIdentity requires independent email verification and still has no normal application authorization

sourceReferences.note: Approved authentication policy requires independent NuvIoT email proof before an unlinked external provider may be linked to an existing durable identity; provider email is supporting evidence only.
